item.title: Highly efficient on-chip erbium-ytterbium co-doped lithium niobate waveguide amplifiers
item.description: arXiv:2306.06998v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The ability to amplify optical signals is of paramount importance in photonic integrated circuits (PICs). Recently, lithium niobate on insulator (LNOI) has attracted increasing interests as an emerging PIC platform. However, the shortage of active devices on LNOI platform limits the development of optical amplification.
